A '''balescream''' is an effect of extreme amounts of [[balefire]] being used against a target. The effects are described as the [[Pattern]] ripping and howling in pain{{ref/book|13|p}} and groaning in agony.{{ref/book|12|37}}

When [[Rand al'Thor]] destroyed [[Natrin's Barrow]] with a massive bolt of balefire, all of the people in proximity felt the balescream.{{ref/book|12|37}} [[Graendal]], being much closer to the event, felt more of the effects.{{ref/book|13|p}}
